# prisma-mariadb-caller-interface-dtos

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Prisma 7. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: mariadb; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: the caller owns the transaction: nothing commits.
- Lists: lists return every row.

## Layout

```text
prisma/schema.prisma   a model per table, as the database has it; the client is generated from it
prisma.config.ts       where the Prisma CLI finds the schema and DATABASE_URL
src/database.ts        the Prisma client: DATABASE_URL, through the driver adapter
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@localhost:3306/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.
